title: Critical Mass: Structure-Disjoint Splits Drift With the Libraries They Are Built On
abstract: arXiv:2610.12694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular machine learning evaluates out-of-distribution performance with structure disjoint splits, a construction rule fixed once at the scale its library happened to have: threshold a pairwise distance, then assign whole connected components to folds. For predicting structures from mass spectra, the field has converged on single-linkage clustering under the myopic Maximum Common Edge Subgraph (MCES) distance at a threshold of 10. This convention was set on 29,000 molecules but public libraries now hold 227,690 molecules. MCES is NP-hard per pair over a quadratically growing set, and so the criterion has never been evaluated at that scale. translated_title: 临界质量：结构不相交的数据划分随其构建所依赖的分子库规模而漂移
translated_abstract: 分子机器学习通过结构不相交划分来评估分布外性能，而这一构建规则在分子库恰好具备的规模上被一次性固定下来：先对成对距离设定阈值，再将整个连通分量分配到各折中。在从质谱预测分子结构的任务中，该领域已收敛于在短视的最大公共边子图（MCES）距离下以阈值10进行单链接聚类。这一惯例是在29,000个分子上确立的，但公共分子库现已包含227,690个分子。由于MCES对每一对分子的计算都是NP难的，且分子对数量随规模呈二次增长，因此该标准从未在这一规模上被评估过。我们提出了该标准的一个优化版本，使其能够在公共分子库上以计算可行的方式应用：通过可采纳的界和并查集跳过机制，将2.6×10¹⁰个分子对减少到仅1.15×10⁷个整数规划问题，节省了2,259倍的计算量，同时可证明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文指出分子机器学习中用于分布外评估的结构不相交划分标准（基于MCES距离阈值10的单链接聚类）是建立在29,000分子规模上的一次性惯例，随分子库增长到22万余分子后已无法计算验证，为此提出结合可采纳界与并查集跳过的优化算法，将计算量降低2,259倍，使该评估标准首次可在现代公共分子库规模上被检验。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the structure-disjoint split convention in molecular machine learning (single-linkage clustering under MCES distance at threshold 10) was fixed at a 29,000-molecule scale and became infeasible to verify as libraries grew to 227,690 molecules, and proposes an optimized criterion using admissible bounds and union-find skips that achieves a 2,259× computational saving, enabling evaluation of the split criterion at modern public library scale for the first time.
